title: GameLounge
description:
GameLounge is an online multiplayer game platform from Renova Games, built to be played with a screen reader. You make a table or join one, pick a game and play, or sit at a table and watch. There are bots to fill a table or play when nobody else is online, text and voice chat, and a Hall of Fame with rankings per game.

Games at launch included AudioDisco (a two-player duel with a disc, taking turns to attack and defend), Showdown (real-time paddle and ball for two), New Undead Assault (a new co-op version of Undead Assault against waves of zombies, up to 6 players), Hitster (place songs on your timeline by release year), Uno, Truco, Scopa, NinetyNine, Cards Against Humanity, Texas Hold'em Poker tournaments, Flip 7, Farkle and Greedy Cave. Hitster and Cards Against Humanity had no English decks yet.

GameLounge is online only and needs an account, which is the same on Windows and Android. It is still early.
